summary: Completed comprehensive testing of HEMELEY new features: VendorProfilePage (Alibaba-style), clickable vendor names on homepage and menu detail page, /restaurant redirect to /vendeur, desktop responsive menu detail page, and admin settings tab. All 14 backend API tests passed. All frontend UI tests passed.
passed_tests: API health check
GET /api/vendors/{vendor_id} returns vendor with stats (completed_orders, completion_rate, menu_count)
GET /api/vendors/{vendor_id} returns 404 for invalid vendor
GET /api/vendors/{vendor_id}/menus returns vendor menus
GET /api/vendors/{vendor_id}/reviews returns vendor reviews
GET /api/menus?zone=bonapriso returns menus with vendor_id and vendor_name
GET /api/menus/{id} returns menu with vendor_id for clickable link
Admin login with admin@hemeley.com / hemeley2024
Admin stats endpoint returns correct data
Admin settings endpoint returns loyalty_rules, time_promotions, referral settings
Admin can add and delete loyalty rules
Admin can add and delete time promotions
GET /api/vendors returns list of vendors with ratings and menu_count
GET /api/vendors?zone=bonapriso filters vendors by zone
Homepage vendor names are clickable links to /vendeur/{vendor_id}
VendorProfilePage loads with vendor info, standing badge, stats, verification badges, menu grid
VendorProfilePage responsive on mobile (390px viewport)
VendorProfilePage 'Ajouter' button opens add-to-cart modal
VendorProfilePage share and favorite buttons present
Menu Detail Page vendor name is clickable link to /vendeur/{vendorId}
Menu Detail Page image constrained with max-w-3xl on desktop
/restaurant/{vendorId} redirects to /vendeur/{vendorId}
Admin dashboard shows 6 tabs (Vue d'ensemble, Vendeurs, Livreurs, Commandes, Clients, Paramètres)
Admin Settings tab displays loyalty rules with toggle and delete
Admin Settings tab displays time promotions with toggle and delete
Admin Settings tab displays referral bonus settings (50 pts new user, 100 pts referrer)
seed_data_creation: Used existing vendor Merlo Dassi (ID: e8427dd9-cb7a-4ebf-baa1-c9fd4d604f2b) for testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: VendorProfilePage fully tested with all features working: hero header, logo, name, rating, zone, member since, standing badge (Nouveau/Actif/Confirmé/Excellence based on orders and completion rate), stats cards (orders, completion rate, menus), verification badges, reviews summary, 4-column menu grid with Ajouter buttons. Clickable vendor names work on homepage menu cards and menu detail page. /restaurant/{id} redirect to /vendeur/{id} working. Admin Settings tab has loyalty rules, time promotions, and referral settings all functional. CAMPAY payment integration is MOCKED on frontend.

vendor_profile_features_tested.standing_badge_logic: Nouveau (<20 orders), Actif (>20 orders), Confirmé (>50 orders, >80% rate), Excellence (>100 orders, >90% rate)
